title: Hoy2024 effort decision LFP: subthalamic/pallidal and prefrontal recordings during an effort-based decision task (DBS surgery)
description: Intraoperative local field potential recordings from the subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus internus and from prefrontal cortex (frontopolar or orbitofrontal) in five patients undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while they performed an effort-based decision-making task. The dataset repackages the authors' OSF release into BIDS as preprocessed bipolar epochs with trial-level behavioural events, together with continuous raw neural exports. It supports study of beta and theta oscillations related to effort and previous reward in the human basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex.
methods_description: Bipolar LFP signals were recorded intraoperatively during DBS surgery at 422 or 500 Hz while participants performed an effort-based decision task. Preprocessed FieldTrip epochs span -2 to 9 s around the offer, with per-trial behavioural variables and model values stored as events. Continuous raw exports were converted to BrainVision float32 format.
